sentences.en: The photo brought back many happy memories of my childhood.
sentences.zh: 这张照片唤起了我童年许多快乐的记忆。

sentences.en: The lecturer dwelt on some memories of his college days.
sentences.zh: 讲师详细讲述了他大学时代的回忆。

sentences.en: My memory failed me. I just couldn't remember his name.
sentences.zh: 我的记忆力让我失望了。我就是想不起他的名字。

senses.zh: 记忆力，记性；回忆，记忆；纪念，纪念物；存储器，内存

collocations.en: in memory of sb./to the memory of sb
